meta.name: Ink Master
meta.description:
Ink Master on Pluto TV is your one-stop shop showcasing the nation’s top tattoo artists in a cutthroat competition, battling it out for $100,000 and the coveted title of ‘Ink Master’. Hosted by Dave Navarro, and tattoo icons Oliver Peck and Chris Nunez.

24/7: Ink Master
Available on: Pluto TV
